items.name: Laptop
items.blurb: You ship code on it. +2 product progress every week.

items.name: Savings Jar
items.blurb: +$8,000 in the bank on day one.

items.name: Idea Napkin
items.blurb: The founding myth. Pitches land a little better.

items.name: Roommate (asleep)
items.blurb: Your future first hire, currently asleep. Unlocks the cofounder talk.

items.name: Energy Drinks
items.blurb: Ship faster, crash harder. Fuels late-night events.

items.name: Girlfriend's Goodwill
items.blurb: Someone still believes in you. Keeps morale from hitting bottom.

items.name: Dignity
items.blurb: Weighs nothing. Surprisingly sellable, much later.

items.name: Gym Membership
items.blurb: $40/week you never use. Cancelable for cash when broke.

items.name: Ping-Pong Paddle
items.blurb: A networking device, technically. Unlocks schmoozing events.

items.name: Dad's Old Server
items.blurb: Heavy. Warm. Hosts everything. +1 product/week, fire hazard.

items.name: Hoodie of Confidence
items.blurb: Founder armor. Confidence in every pitch.

items.name: Bus Pass
items.blurb: You can physically get to meetings. Underrated.

items.name: Textbook (sellable)
items.blurb: Sellable for ~$120. Sorry, education.

items.name: Guitar
items.blurb: Four chords against the dark. Restores morale when it counts.

items.name: Houseplant
items.blurb: Attends your standups. Listens. +morale each week.

items.name: Soldering iron
items.blurb: Real things need real heat. Hardware builds go a little faster.

items.name: Multimeter
items.blurb: Tells you which of the three identical boards is lying.

items.name: Label printer
items.blurb: Both sides of the market get a tracking number. Feels like control.

items.name: Industrial tape
items.blurb: Holds boxes, demos, and occasionally the business together.

items.name: The good blazer
items.blurb: You ARE the product, and the product irons its blazer.

items.name: Billable-hours watch
items.blurb: Every glance at it converts guilt into an invoice line.

items.name: Conference lanyard
items.blurb: Gets you into buildings where the buyers hide behind procurement.

items.name: CRM free trial
items.blurb: Fourteen days to track a thousand small checks. Day 15 is a decision.

items.name: Ring light
items.blurb: Consumer apps live and die on camera. You will too.
